what: The recommendation-ranking use case measured end to end on a consumer laptop GPU, to show the loop works off the cluster: give it a traffic mix, it tunes for those shapes, and the gain is measured on the same machine.
gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU (sm_86, 8 GB, 46 SMs)
traffic_mix: 42% realtime_light, 18% realtime_heavy, 25% batched_peak, 15% rerank -- shares illustrative and settable, shapes are the point
caveat: A laptop cannot lock its clocks, so absolute latencies drift with thermals between runs; the ratios are the stable quantity. Board power is unknown for this part, so the energy line is omitted rather than guessed. Every row cleared the organizer's accuracy gate before it was timed.
pipeline: cli tune -> cli agent --provider llm -> scripts/usecase.py. The agent proposed 20 configurations across the four shapes; 16 cleared the gate, 4 were rejected, and one beat the frozen plan by enough to take the slot: cuda_graph_fp16_flash_optimized at 4.60x against 3.34x held.
